notes.title: v0.7.12 QOL/BugFixes
notes.notes:
v0.7.12

QOL:
-Sound listener now attached to player instead of camera for 3rd person view
-Your last manually chosen color saves as your color preference
-Adjusted ‘hacked’ text effect on power failure
-Increased USN Prometheus map scale by 25%
-Removed placeholder image that appears during skillchecks

BUG FIXES:
-Fixed assignment of player color if player joining mid-match
-Fixed issue for calculating required points to win (Simplified calculation to be 1 task = 1 point)
-Fixed issue where host would see glitching map icons for their tasks or not see them at all

notes.title: v0.7.7 - Big QOL update
notes.notes:
v0.7.7

Bug fixes:
-Opening and closing the pause menu now correctly re-enables the mouse if using keyboard/mouse
-Potential fix for getting stuck in smaller door hatches on  USN prometheus
-Fix for assigned task counts not respecting gameplay settings configured in lobby

QOL: 
-If a human leaves mid-match, any un-finished tasks they have been assigned are no longer required for victory
-changed default setting for human to third person view
-Androids can now see in-game icons for vents
-Non-hosts can no longer change map
-Non-hosts can no longer change public/private
-Opening and closing the pause menu now sets your default focus to the first player card
-Defaulted maintenance shaft doors to open
-Added purple light to maintenance shaft doors to high light them more as doors
-Players who join in the middle of a round will now spawn dead
-increased range at which you can interact with emergency meeting terminal by 50%
-(client-side fix) can no longer vote after time runs out
-drop off zone icon visible when dead
-appeased the grammar nazi king and queens by adjusting text on lobby wall
-ghosts can now see each others' names
-changed action1 default bind to Left Mouse Button One for PC. Right bumper for xbox
-in-game keybind displays now correctly update when switching between PC and xbox
-changed interaction method to toggle for reactor repair
-increased volume for skill check prompt
-increased visibility of skill check icon
-added repeating warning for reactor mal function
-in-game task indicators for power failures and reactor failures now pulse when hacked
-tweaked fp view
-tweaked fp view for crouch
-can no longer see self if ghost and fp view
-if getting merc'd in fp view, forces 3rd person view for the actionz
-made gameplay settings more human-readable

Easter Huevos
-added 2 easter eggs on ceres station
-added "4" "easter eggs" in lobby

notes.title: v0.5.6 Update
notes.notes:
V0.5.6


 Feature: Added chat. Press Y to input a message.
 Feature: CHAT: Can only chat to other players while in meetings or other DEAD people
 Feature: CHAT: Chat window now shows during voting
 Feature: Added Host Configurable setting for task difficulty. Defaults to 80. Affects timing leniency on reflex-based tasks
 Feature: Game session settings now increment/decrement by 10% of range if number options are > 10. IE: Android Kill Cooldown now modified by 5 seconds per increment/decrement

notes.notes:

added static effect on security cam monitor for transitioning between cameras
fixed issue where cams would not be in sync for players in multiplayer

notes.title: v0.5.2 Update
notes.notes:
v0.5.2 has been released. A small update containing the following changes:


Security Cameras are now across the station
Security Cameras will pan left and right while active
Security Cameras will glow red while active
Security Camera monitor is available on the station. Press F to cycle the camera
You can now explore the station in practice mode. Look for the door ;)

notes.title: Countdown Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
We are a go for early access release! 

Currently working features:

Humans:
Proximity chat
Call emergency meetings by reporting dead bodies to vote to eject the rogue AI
Complete tasks to delay the prepare your ship for evacuation
Androids will attempt to thwart your efforts by hacking your visor or ejecting you from the airlock

Androids:
Kill humans and frame other humans
Hack the systems on board to prey on the humans

Features:
Customize victory conditions and various cooldowns
In game chat
Pick your color

Please report any bugs on the steam community forum. Or if you're interested in joining our discord, let us know and we can give you a invite link.

bugs@hellofriendgames.com
